data.title: Invoice for painting work – Malerbetrieb Muster
data.summary: Malerbetrieb Muster billed Mara Beispiel a total of 1,130.50 EUR (incl. 19% VAT) for painting three rooms at Lindenweg 12, work completed on 12.08.2026. Payment is due within 14 days of receiving this invoice, by bank transfer to the company's account.
data.explanation: This is a craftsman's invoice (Rechnung), not a bill from an authority. You are asked to transfer 1,130.50 EUR to the painter's bank account by the deadline shown, counted from when you received this letter. There is no formal objection procedure here (this is a private invoice, not an official decision), but if you disagree with the amount or work quality you should contact the company directly. Because the work was done in your home and paid by bank transfer, part of the labour cost may be deductible on your German tax return under craftsman services (Handwerkerleistungen, §35a EStG) — keep this invoice and proof of the bank transfer for your tax records.
